tierReason: Photos add a table, signed Cloudinary uploads, synced writes and API endpoints; fits one cycle

decisions.decision: Tier Feature for #9, Sensitive Areas data, schema, api
decisions.why: New table, server-signed uploads holding a secret, and API endpoints with permission checks

decisions.decision: Involved people of a task are its creator plus its assignees
decisions.why: Same group as #8 and Decision 13; the user chose it at the mockup review

decisions.decision: Images use Cloudinary 'authenticated' delivery with signed URLs handed out only in the members-only photo list; links don't expire
decisions.why: Meets Decision 7 on the free plan; expiring token links need a paid Cloudinary plan

decisions.decision: Photos are resized to 1600 px on the longer side, JPEG, before upload
decisions.why: Keeps uploads small on mobile data while staying sharp enough for receipts

decisions.decision: The API answers 503 photos_unavailable when Cloudinary variables are missing, instead of failing at startup
decisions.why: Local dev and tests keep working before the user sets up Cloudinary

decisions.decision: Use Cloudinary's official Node SDK on the server and Expo's picker/manipulator modules on the phone
decisions.why: Prior art: official libraries avoid hand-written signature bugs; all Expo modules run in Expo Go
Migration order (lesson) and the task screen's section order depend on #8

decisions.decision: Stacked #9 on the #8 branch instead of waiting for #8 to merge
decisions.why: The user asked for both in one hands-off run; the photos migration then sorts after the comments migration and the task screen already has Bình luận. Merge #8 first.

serviceActions: Create a Cloudinary account (free plan), then set CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME, CLOUDINARY_API_KEY and CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET in Render and in apps/api/.env
